authored_declarations.name: Trees.fold
authored_declarations.header_text: def fold (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β) : BinaryTree α → β

authored_declarations.name: Trees.fold_nil
authored_declarations.header_text:
@[simp] theorem fold_nil (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β) :
    fold empty combine .nil = empty

authored_declarations.name: Trees.fold_node
authored_declarations.header_text:
@[simp] theorem fold_node (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    fold empty combine (.node a l r) =
      combine (fold empty combine l) a (fold empty combine r)

authored_declarations.name: Trees.fold_map
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem fold_map (empty : β) (combine : β → γ → β → β)
    (label : α → γ) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    fold empty combine (t.map label) =
      fold empty (fun l a r => combine l (label a) r) t

authored_declarations.name: Trees.fold_fusion
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem fold_fusion (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (empty' : γ) (combine' : γ → α → γ → γ) (observe : β → γ)
    (h_empty : observe empty = empty')
    (h_node : ∀ l a r, observe (combine l a r) =
      combine' (observe l) a (observe r)) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    observe (fold empty combine t) = fold empty' combine' t

authored_declarations.name: Trees.fold_numNodes
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem fold_numNodes (t : BinaryTree α) :
    fold (0 : Nat) (fun l (_ : α) r => l + r + 1) t = t.numNodes

authored_declarations.name: Trees.fold_height
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem fold_height (t : BinaryTree α) :
    fold (0 : Nat) (fun l (_ : α) r => max l r + 1) t = t.height

authored_declarations.name: Trees.inorder_node
authored_declarations.header_text:
@[simp] theorem inorder_node (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    inorder (.node a l r) = inorder l ++ (a :: inorder r)

authored_declarations.name: Trees.inorder_length
authored_declarations.header_text: theorem inorder_length (t : BinaryTree α) : (inorder t).length = t.numNodes

authored_declarations.name: Trees.inorder_map
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem inorder_map (label : α → β) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    inorder (t.map label) = (inorder t).map label

authored_declarations.name: Trees.Cached.valid_node

@[simp] theorem valid_node (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (a : α) (b : β) (l r : BinaryTree (α × β)) :
    Valid empty combine (.node (a, b) l r) ↔
      Valid empty combine l ∧ Valid empty combine r ∧
        b = combine (read empty l) a (read empty r)

    Valid empty combine (smartNode empty combine l a r) ↔
      Valid empty combine l ∧ Valid empty combine r

authored_declarations.name: Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun
Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun_value
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem nodeRun_value (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (combineRun : β → α → β → Measured β Nat)
    (l : BinaryTree (α × β)) (a : α) (r : BinaryTree (α × β))
    (hvalue : (combineRun (Trees.Cached.read empty l) a
      (Trees.Cached.read empty r)).1 =
      combine (Trees.Cached.read empty l) a (Trees.Cached.read empty r)) :
    (nodeRun empty combineRun l a r).1 =
      Trees.Cached.smartNode empty combine l a r

authored_declarations.name: Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun_cost
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem nodeRun_cost (empty : β) (combineRun : β → α → β → Measured β Nat)
    (l : BinaryTree (α × β)) (a : α) (r : BinaryTree (α × β)) :
    (nodeRun empty combineRun l a r).2 =
      (combineRun (Trees.Cached.read empty l) a (Trees.Cached.read empty r)).2 + 3

authored_declarations.name: Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun_le
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem nodeRun_le (empty : β) (combineRun : β → α → β → Measured β Nat)
    (l : BinaryTree (α × β)) (a : α) (r : BinaryTree (α × β)) (K : Nat)
    (hcost : (combineRun (Trees.Cached.read empty l) a
      (Trees.Cached.read empty r)).2 ≤ K) :
    (nodeRun empty combineRun l a r).2 ≤ K + 3

authored_declarations.name: Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun_valid
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem nodeRun_valid (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (combineRun : β → α → β → Measured β Nat)
    (l : BinaryTree (α × β)) (a : α) (r : BinaryTree (α × β))
    (hl : Trees.Cached.Valid empty combine l)
    (hr : Trees.Cached.Valid empty combine r)
    (hvalue : (combineRun (Trees.Cached.read empty l) a
      (Trees.Cached.read empty r)).1 =
      combine (Trees.Cached.read empty l) a (Trees.Cached.read empty r)) :
    Trees.Cached.Valid empty combine (nodeRun empty combineRun l a r).1

def appendStepRun (l : List α) (a : α) (r : List α) :
    Resources.Measured (List α) Nat

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.append_node_value
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem append_node_value (l : BinaryTree (α × List α)) (a : α)
    (r : BinaryTree (α × List α)) :
    (Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun [] appendStepRun l a r).1 =
      Trees.Cached.smartNode [] listStep l a r

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.append_node_cost
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem append_node_cost (l : BinaryTree (α × List α)) (a : α)
    (r : BinaryTree (α × List α)) :
    (Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun [] appendStepRun l a r).2 =
      (Trees.Cached.read [] l).length + 4

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.append_node_valid
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem append_node_valid (l : BinaryTree (α × List α)) (a : α)
    (r : BinaryTree (α × List α))
    (hl : Trees.Cached.Valid [] listStep l) (hr : Trees.Cached.Valid [] listStep r) :
    Trees.Cached.Valid [] listStep (Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun [] appendStepRun l a r).1

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.chain
authored_declarations.header_text: def chain : Nat → BinaryTree Unit

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.chain_numNodes
authored_declarations.header_text: theorem chain_numNodes (n : Nat) : (chain n).numNodes = n

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.chainCache
authored_declarations.header_text: def chainCache (n : Nat) : BinaryTree (Unit × List Unit)

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.chainCache_valid
authored_declarations.header_text: theorem chainCache_valid (n : Nat) : Trees.Cached.Valid [] listStep (chainCache n)

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.chainCache_read
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem chainCache_read (n : Nat) :
    Trees.Cached.read [] (chainCache n) = Trees.inorder (chain n)

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.chainCache_length
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem chainCache_length (n : Nat) :
    (Trees.Cached.read [] (chainCache n)).length = n

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.chain_node_cost
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem chain_node_cost (n : Nat) :
    (Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun [] appendStepRun (chainCache n) () .nil).2 = n + 4

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.chain_node_value
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem chain_node_value (n : Nat) :
    (Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun [] appendStepRun (chainCache n) () .nil).1 =
      chainCache (n + 1)

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.chain_node_valid
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem chain_node_valid (n : Nat) :
    Trees.Cached.Valid [] listStep
      (Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun [] appendStepRun (chainCache n) () .nil).1

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.chain_node_exceeds
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem chain_node_exceeds (K : Nat) :
    K < (Resources.TreeCache.nodeRun [] appendStepRun (chainCache (K + 1)) () .nil).2

authored_declarations.name: TreeCacheExamples.empty_read
authored_declarations.header_text:
theorem empty_read {β : Type v} (empty : β) :
    Resources.TreeCache.readRun empty (.nil : BinaryTree (Empty × β)) = (empty, 1)
